work_item: A02: independently implemented 8-bit 420 chroma whole-edge SSE2

source.before: A01 plus a Chroma4208 forwarding-only stub and benchmark calls to that stub; no production algorithm or routing change
source.before_extra_test_source: An unused temporary BenchmarkDeblockFrame test was compiled, then removed; formal full-frame comparison uses the existing BenchmarkDeblock_1080p_Auto
source.final: A01 plus this A02 implementation, integration and tests; source dirty at measurement, committed together with this evidence
source.pilot: Initial A02 before asmdecl vet repair. Final accesses the bS array through its address and reuses the strong mask; same arithmetic, fewer instructions. Pilot samples are retained but excluded from final adoption claims.

dispatch.before: FilterLumaEdge=SSE2, FilterDelta=Generic; chroma uses old scalar segments
dispatch.final: FilterLumaEdge=SSE2, FilterChromaEdge=SSE2, FilterDelta=Generic; only progressive 8-bit 420 uses the new chroma slot

timing.chroma: A00 fixed 696-byte destination reset plus one eight-line prepared edge; stride29, q0=121, preparation/checks excluded; 8/10-bit x two directions x seven scenarios
timing.deblock: Existing BenchmarkDeblock_1080p_Auto intra=true/false: fixed three-plane reset plus real deblockPlane, metadata/QP/bS and all Y/Cb/Cr edges; coded size1920x1088, no decode/IO
timing.endpoints: New/Send/Receive/Release/Flush/Close; input file IO and AU assembly excluded. IDR=one frame/op, 500ms; IPB=32 frames/op,1x. Initial before/final have count5 in one process.
timing.paired_endpoints: Five interleaved pairs alternating execution order, count=1 per process. IDR retains500ms; IPB retains1x and includes cold process-pool effects. Full-frame retains300ms with two cases. Compare the paired series to each other, not to count5 batch medians.
timing.raw_sample_fields: ns_op, b_op, allocs_op and iteration counts; frames_s is the benchmark rounded raw metric when present

inputs.source: docs/performance.md sections17/18; same files and generation settings, not regenerated

commands.compile: CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -c -o <executable> ./internal/filter | ./decoder | ./benchmarks (one package per invocation, completed before timing)
commands.paired: Same commands, count=1; fresh before/final executables per pair, before/after order alternates. In each IDR/full-frame pair, each side runs its IDR process then its full-frame process.

validation.routine_cgo0: gofmt -l . (empty); go vet ./...; go build ./...; go test ./...; tools/depscheck (36 packages); tools/manifest (55 inputs), all passed; unaffected test caches reused
validation.targeted: go test -tags goavc_simdtest ./internal/simd ./internal/filter -count=1: new direct SSE2 full-buffer differential/analytic/guard-page and forced chroma-slot tests passed
validation.escaping: internal/filter/chroma_420_edge.go: data does not escape; AllocsPerRun uses arrays inside the closure, both eligible directions and fallback are0alloc
validation.independent_oracle: Both final direct-AU FFmpeg8.0 pixel tests passed; selected encoder DecisionCorpus, InterSequence, BFrameReorder, CABACSequence, Transform8x8 and WeightedPrediction Oracle groups passed, plus routine tests/codec
validation.purego: simd/decoder/encoder passed with purego,goavc_simdtest; filter initially exposed the existing A01 SSE2-unavailable fatal. Fixed the forced A01 test/benchmark to skip unavailable backends; filter rerun passed. SSE2 skips are not counted as Generic/SSE2 execution evidence.
validation.cross: Six OS/arch combinations (windows/linux/darwin x amd64/arm64): go build ./... and go test -c ./internal/simd passed; compile evidence only
validation.race: CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race ./internal/simd ./internal/filter ./decoder ./encoder -count=1 passed; regular commands use CGO0
validation.deferred: 300-frame main matrix remains at A07; no new native arm64/Unix execution, full-library race, fuzz or long stability run
validation.local_logs: tmp/a02; numerical samples are archived in this JSON; initial asmdecl error fixed by bounded bS loads through the array address, final code revalidated and rebuilt before final timing

decision.auto: Enable SSE2 for eligible vertical and horizontal 8-bit420 progressive edges; old entry paths and fallback retained
decision.basis: Active-edge microbenchmarks improve about40%-61%; final paired full-frame intra/inter improve14.1%/10.2%, IDR5.7%; IPB paired medians differ-0.1%, no confirmed IPB speedup or reproducible regression
decision.batch_drift: Frozen before IPB median changed from1094570400 in the original batch to1322296300 in final pairing (+20.8%). Execution conditions changed across batches; cause not monitored. Final endpoint adoption uses the paired series, preserves original batch numbers and does not claim the unpaired deltas as implementation regressions.
decision.allocation_observation: All chroma edge microbench samples0B/0alloc; paired full-frame all0alloc, one inter-frame sample3B/op, all other paired full-frame samples0B/op. Retained exactly; local-array noescape/0alloc checks passed.
decision.next: A03 only under subsequent authorization; A07 retains the300-frame main comparison
